profile.headline: Lead Mobile Application Developer (Flutter || Android || IOS) *Android Jet Compose *Dart, Kotlin , Java *Cloud Computing Certified (AWS || GCP || AZURE) QA Automation Typescript, Webdriver.io DDD Framework
profile.summary:
Over 7 years of experience driving mobile app development across Flutter, Android(Java/Kotlin, Jet Compose) and iOS, with a strong focus on modern architectures and test automation (WebDriverIO, TypeScript, Cucumber). Expert in building scalable, maintainable apps using Jetpack Compose for declarative UI and seamless Android experiences.

My experience includes integrating third-party services like Twilio and payment gateways, working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), state management (RiverPod, Bloc, Provider, GetX) and implementing CI/CD pipelines to optimize workflows and ensure high-quality software delivery. Additionally, I have a strong background in Agile methodologies and collaborative teamwork. I am skilled in test automation, including UI testing, functional testing, and API testing using WebDriverIO and Cucumber. I also have strong leadership and project management experience, having successfully led mobile development for a leading U.S. healthcare company and an Abu Dhabi-based e-commerce platform.

positions.title: Lead Flutter Js and Native Mobile Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Led the development and maintenance of multiple Lumi Rx mobile applications,
including a native Android app built with Jetpack Compose and kotlin and a cross-
platform Flutter app, ensuring a consistent and responsive UI/UX across devices and
platforms.

Mentor junior and mid-level developers, guiding them on best practices, design patterns, and architecture decisions.
Encourage a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing within the development team
Pair program with developers to resolve complex issues and support skill development
Implemented NFC (Near Field Communication) support in Flutter via platform channels, allowing secure, contactless data exchange for prescription validation and medical device check-ins.
Built native NFC functionality for:
Android Instant App: Integrated NFC tag reading (NfcAdapter, NdefMessage) into lightweight Instant App modules, enabling frictionless patient onboarding without full app installation.
iOS App Clip: Leveraged Core NFC within App Clips to allow fast, secure NFC interactions without requiring the full app, aligned with iOS design and privacy guidelines.
positions.insights: Skills: Flutter · Dart · Kotlin · Android jetpack · Kotlin Coroutines · State Management · Ktor · Android Development

positions.title: Senior Flutter Developer
positions.description:
Led the design and development of MyVCA mobile application
. Team Leadership: Led and mentored a team of junior developers, ensuring code quality through reviews and guidance on best practices.
. Mobile App Development: Expertise in building high-performance mobile applications using Flutter and Dart, ensuring seamless user experiences across devices.
State Management: Skilled in managing app state with Provider, BLoC, Riverpod, and GetX.
. API Integration: Proficient in integrating REST APIs and GraphQL for remote data handling and optimizing API flows.
. Cloud & DevOps: Experienced in using Microsoft Azure DevOps for version control and CI/CD pipelines.
. Third-Party Integrations:
* Integrated Helpshift for in-app customer support.
* Added Amplitude, Logstash for performance tuning and analytics.
* Implemented Firebase and OneSignal for push notifications.
* Integrated Facebook, Google, and Apple login with Firebase Authentication and OAuth.
. Call & Video Integration: Integrated Flutter Call Kit and AVPlayerLayer for native call and video functionalities.
. Error Handling & Security: Implemented modern authorization with JWT and ensured smooth authentication across devices and networks.
Accessibility: Focused on implementing accessibility features for better app usability.
. Chat System: Designed and integrated chat systems supporting video, images, and PDFs with optimized performance.
. App Store Optimization: Published and optimized apps on Google Play Store and Apple App Store, improving app ratings.

positions.title: Lead Flutter Developer
positions.description:
led the Design and development for HALEN SUPER APP using Flutter and AWS Amplify.
Integrated AWS authentication and authorization for secure login and API access.
Implemented agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, and sprint planning.
Built interactive UX designs using Figma and optimized app usability.
Keep the entire application aligned with coding standards.
Implemented CDN integration in a Flutter application to optimize image and asset delivery, improving load times by 40%.
Implemented Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for push notifications across all app states, ensuring real-time updates and enhanced user engagement.
